Total size of Proton Drive folders

Source: R/pd_size.R
pd_size.Rd

Calculates the total size of each folder and how many items it holds, counting all descendants, including trashed ones. The calculation runs on the server; nothing is downloaded.

This needs a Proton Drive CLI with the filesystem size command. CLI 0.8.0 does not have it; it is in development in the Proton Drive SDK repository. Older CLIs give an error of class protondrive_unsupported.

Usage

pd_size(file)

Arguments

file

Folders, as paths, IDs marked with as_id(), or a dribble.

Value

A tibble with columns name, path, size (bytes), and n_items.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
pd_size("~")
pd_ls(type = "folder") |> pd_size()
} # }
